review_workload_forecast.suggested_split: PR 1 → Foundation + server components (tasks 1.1–1.2, 2.1–2.7, 3.2) | PR 2 → LeadForm client component (3.1) | PR 3 → app/page.tsx migration (4.1–4.2)

suggested_work_units.goal: Foundation + all server components + composition root
suggested_work_units.notes: Base = main. Creates layout, content.ts, lead.schema.ts, 7 server components, and landing/page.tsx. Verify via pnpm dev + navigate to /landing.
Base = main (independent). Client island with RHF + Zod + Formspree. Depends on content.ts and lead.schema.ts from PR 1.
Base = main. Strip 'use client', hooks, modal. Run pnpm build to confirm no errors.

phases.name: Foundation / Infrastructure
phases.focus: New types, interfaces, layout, data, config — things other tasks depend on

tasks.title: Create (marketing)/layout.tsx with SEO metadata and fonts
tasks.description: Create route-group layout at `app/(marketing)/layout.tsx` as a server component with marketing OG metadata defaults, viewport config, and Onest font loading. No auth providers.
acceptance_criteria: Layout renders as SSR without 'use client'
OG metadata, viewport, and Onest font load correctly
No auth providers or client wrappers included

tasks.title: Create features/landing/data/content.ts with all hardcoded copy
tasks.description: Create data file exporting typed objects: hero content, game modes array (3 items), how-it-works steps (3), pricing plans (2), comparison rows (6 criteria × 3 competitors), FAQ items (6), footer brand/socials, and lead form labels. All copy in Spanish.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 sections' data exported as typed consts/arrays
Pricing shows S/75 and S/35 correctly
Social links include Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, YouTube

tasks.title: Create features/landing/schema/lead.schema.ts with Zod validation
tasks.description: Create Zod schema for lead form: nombre (string, min 2), email (valid email), teléfono (string, min 9 digits), edad_hijo (number, int, range 3–6). Export inferred type.

phases.name: Server Components
phases.focus: 7 SSR section components using hardcoded content from content.ts

tasks.title: Create Hero.tsx with gradient background and CTA scroll
tasks.description: Server component at `features/landing/components/Hero.tsx`. Shows title 'Aprendizaje de palabras que cobra vida', phygital subtitle, CTA 'Quiero saber más' (scrolls to #lead-form). Background: `from-primary-500 via-primary-400 to-primary-600` gradient. Floating icons from Icon library.
acceptance_criteria: Title, subtitle, CTA render from content.ts
CTA scrolls to lead form on click

tasks.title: Create GameModes.tsx with 3 cards
tasks.description: Server component at `features/landing/components/GameModes.tsx`. Renders 3 cards (Cámara, OCR, Speech to Text) with icon, title, description. Responsive grid: single column mobile, 3 columns md+.
acceptance_criteria: 3 cards render with icon + title + description

tasks.title: Create HowItWorks.tsx with 3 numbered steps
tasks.description: Server component at `features/landing/components/HowItWorks.tsx`. Renders 3 sequential steps with numbering: 'Comprá el kit (S/75)', 'Descargá la app', 'Tu hijo aprende jugando'. Horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive layout: vertical mobile, horizontal md+

tasks.title: Create Pricing.tsx with 2 plan cards
tasks.description: Server component at `features/landing/components/Pricing.tsx`. Renders 'Plan Anual' (S/75) and 'Renovación' (S/35/año) cards with price, features list, CTA. Side-by-side on md+, stacked on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Both plan cards render with correct prices

tasks.title: Create ComparisonTable.tsx with competitor grid
tasks.description: Server component at `features/landing/components/ComparisonTable.tsx`. Renders comparison of AlphaKids vs Khan Academy Kids vs Duolingo ABC across 6 criteria. Card layout on mobile, <table> on md+.

tasks.title: Create FAQ.tsx with accordion and JSON-LD schema
tasks.description: Server component at `features/landing/components/FAQ.tsx`. Renders 6 expandable FAQ items (click to toggle). Injects `<script type="application/ld+json">` with valid FAQPage schema (schema.org). Uses client toggle for expand/collapse on each item.
acceptance_criteria: 6 FAQ items render with expand/collapse toggle
JSON-LD <script> with FAQPage schema in HTML source

tasks.title: Create Footer.tsx with brand, social icons, copyright
tasks.description: Server component at `features/landing/components/Footer.tsx`. Shows AlphaKids brand, 4 social icons (Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, YouTube) as links, and copyright text. Data from content.ts.

tasks.title: Create LeadForm.tsx with RHF + Zod + Formspree POST
tasks.description: Client component ('use client') at `features/landing/components/LeadForm.tsx`. Uses react-hook-form + zodResolver(leadSchema). POSTs to `https://formspree.io/f/{NEXT_PUBLIC_FORMSPREE_ID}`. On 2xx: show '¡Gracias! Te contactaremos pronto'. On error: show inline error. Fields: nombre, email, teléfono, edad_hijo.
acceptance_criteria: Happy path: valid data → POST to Formspree → success message
Validation: empty required fields → inline errors, no POST
Uses NEXT_PUBLIC_FORMSPREE_ID env var (placeholder if unset)
Scroll target id='lead-form' matches Hero CTA

tasks.title: Create landing/page.tsx as composition root
tasks.description: Create `app/(marketing)/landing/page.tsx` as a server component that imports and composes all 8 sections in order: Hero, GameModes, HowItWorks, Pricing, ComparisonTable, FAQ, LeadForm, Footer. Each section separated by spacing sections.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 sections render in correct order at /landing
Page SSR without JS required (except LeadForm)

phases.name: Migration + Build Verification
phases.focus: Clean up app/page.tsx and ensure build passes

tasks.title: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_FORMSPREE_ID to .env.example
tasks.description: Add `NEXT_PUBLIC_FORMSPREE_ID=your-formspree-id` to `.env.example` with a comment explaining it's required for the landing page lead form.

tasks.title: Migrate app/page.tsx to pure server component
tasks.description: Strip `'use client'` directive, remove React hooks (useState, useEffect), remove LoginForm/Modal imports and references. Convert to pure server component rendering static content.
acceptance_criteria: Build compiles without client directive errors

tasks.title: Run pnpm build and fix any compilation errors
tasks.description: Execute `pnpm build` and resolve any TypeScript or Next.js compilation errors introduced by the landing page changes.
